pricing_snapshot.source: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (unauthenticated), 2026-11-01: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free returned HTTP 404 (no longer listed) on the first search-loop run and was replaced
pricing_snapshot.selection_rule: pricing.prompt == "0" && pricing.completion == "0" (and request/web_search absent or "0"), context_length >= 32000, text output, general instruct model; meta-routers (openrouter/free) excluded because they choose the model for us

excluded_models._rule: Dead or refused ids; never routed.

github_models_note: GitHub Models free tier through the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN (caller grants permissions: models: read). Paid usage is opt-in in GitHub billing and is never enabled; a 429 is the free limit, not a bill.
gemini_models_note: Gemini API free tier through GEMINI_API_KEY (a Google AI Studio key whose project has NO billing account, so it can never be charged; free-tier requests per model per day). Daily-quota 429 closes the lane for the run.

workers_ai._why: The account's free Workers AI allowance is 10,000 neurons/day and overage is billed. Studios hold 8,500 (creator-studios worker/lib/freeAi.ts, @cf/mistralai/mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct). The engine uses a model nobody else uses so its own usage is measurable, reads today's usage from Cloudflare analytics before every call, stops at 600 neurons/day of its own and whenever the whole account is past 9,000, and fails closed if usage cannot be read. Rates: $0.345/$0.556 per M tokens at $0.011 per 1,000 neurons, rounded up.
